title: Minimising Risks when SGX-listed Companies Experience Sudden Deterioration in Financial Viability
what_it_is: Minimising Risks when SGX-listed Companies Experience Sudden Deterioration in Financial Viability

sections.label: SGX listing disclosure rules
sections.summary: SGX listing rules require listed companies to disclose all material information about their business, financial condition and prospects in a timely and accurate way.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Under the Singapore Exchange's (SGX's) listing rules, listed companies are required to provide timely and accurate disclosure of all material information concerning their business, financial condition and prospects.

sections.label: Public queries in 2018
sections.summary: In financial year 2018, it issued more than 400 public queries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: For example, in financial year 2018, it issued more than 400 public queries.

sections.label: Fast Track compliance programme
sections.summary: Under the Fast Track programme, companies with good compliance and governance records get faster processing of submissions, while poor records face increased scrutiny.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Under its new Fast Track programme, companies which maintain a good history of compliance and corporate governance standards will enjoy faster processing times for company submissions, such as circulars, and share issuance applications, while those with poor compliance records will be subject to increased scrutiny.

sections.label: Timelines for investigating complaints
sections.summary: The question asks whether SGX RegCo and MAS have clear timelines for investigating concerns and complaints raised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In the understanding of SGX RegCo and MAS, are there clear timelines that are set as an expectation to investigate concerns and complaints that are raised?

sections.label: Noble Group audit opinions
sections.summary: Regulators reviewed the allegations since 2015, but clean audit opinions from Ernst & Young and PricewaterhouseCoopers made investigation difficult until substantial write-downs in late 2017 and early 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The regulators have been working together since 2015 when those allegations came out to carefully review the allegations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: But the circumstances of this case are quite different.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: They are peculiar because Noble Group's statutory auditor Ernst & Young (Hong Kong) has always given clean audit opinions to the company, even in the years following the Iceberg Research reports.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Another audit firm, PricewaterhouseCoopers Singapore, independently reviewed Noble Group's accounting practices, specifically on its mark-to-market valuation practices, which were highlighted by Iceberg Research, and again, gave it a clean opinion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: In this case, because of all the clean opinions by the auditors – and these are the Big Four, reputable auditors – it was difficult to mount an investigation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: But, following a substantial write-down of their accounts in late 2017 and early 2018, the authorities now have something to go on.
